text.title: Poetry Project Setup — Output Contract
text.summary: Output schema for the subagent applying python-poetry-setup. Encodes required boolean checks against the artefact under review.

example.code: { "pep621_present": true, "lockfile_committed": true, "dev_group_separate": true, "venv_in_project": true, "python_constraint": "^3.11", "ci_install": "poetry install --sync --no-interaction", "deps_groups": ["main", "dev", "test", "docs"], "docker_multi_stage": { "builder_uses": "poetry export", "final_uses": "pip install -r requirements.txt" }, "ci_caches_venv": true }

# pyproject.toml [project] name = "acme" version = "0.1.0" requires-python = ">=3.11"
[tool.poetry.dependencies] python = "^3.11"
[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies] ruff = "^0.4"
[tool.poetry.group.test.dependencies] pytest = "^8"
[tool.poetry.group.docs] optional = true [tool.poetry.group.docs.dependencies] mkdocs = "^1.5"
# CI step - run: poetry install --sync --no-interaction
# Dockerfile FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder RUN pip install poetry COPY pyproject.toml poetry.lock ./ RUN poetry export -f requirements.txt -o /tmp/req.txt --without-hashes
FROM python:3.11-slim COPY --from=builder /tmp/req.txt . RUN pip install -r req.txt
example.note: PEP 621 metadata, four dep groups with docs optional, --sync in CI, Poetry confined to the builder stage.

example.code:
# pyproject.toml — REJECTED python = ">=3.8" # broad constraint (r8) # poetry.lock in .gitignore # lockfile not committed (r2)
# Dockerfile FROM python:3.11 COPY . . RUN pip install poetry && poetry install # Poetry in the final stage (r10)
example.note: Three violations: broad Python range, uncommitted lockfile, Poetry shipped to production.
All gates red; methodology not applied — fix the violations before claiming completion.

list.item: Every required boolean field is present and true.
Artefact references the rule id from 01-core-rules.xml (e.g., r1-pep621-layout).
No extra properties outside the schema.
Python constraint is `^3.11` or newer, never a broad `>=` range.
Dep groups main/dev/test declared, with docs marked optional.
Dockerfile is multi-stage; the final stage uses pip + requirements.txt, never `poetry install`.
CI caches .venv keyed by OS + Python version + poetry.lock hash.
